name: Immortals
s: Mia, whose greatest desire is to become a human again, will go into great collaboration with young rebels in order to destroy Dmitry, who transformed her into a vampire to get back to life. Mia and Dmitry's roads will intersect in a luxury nightclub in Istanbul. Mia will stay in love between good and evil vampires.

paragraphs.text: Immortals () is a 2018 Turkish web series starring Elçin Sangu, Kerem Bürsin and Birkan Sokullu.
